articles.summary: Evans General Contractors is a national GC building some of the most complex projects in the country — data centers, advanced manufacturing and logistics, andlife sciences. They needed cost management to match. After an integration that flooded Autodesk with bad data and left their team without support, they found Agave. Six months later: a dozen live projects, enforced workflows, and a cost visibility story their leadership can actually trust.
articles.title: How Evans General Contractors Brought Real Cost Controls to Complex Projects with Agave
